acceptance.given: Disposable, contained inspection roots with otherwise compliant packages and explicit local dependency authorities, independently varied to contain a missing required record, an unresolved authority reference, or an incompatible version. Expected diagnostic classifications and dependency identities are frozen in test code independently of candidate policy.

oracle.expected: Each defective variant returns status fail and authorizes=[], with a typed blocking package diagnostic attributable to that variant's dependency identity and defect. Independently frozen expectations check the stable rule ID, diagnostic code and package-relative record context. Execution observers record no dependency invocation. The corresponding repaired control removes the dependency diagnostic.
forbidden: Returning pass or legacy for any defective variant.
Reporting only an unrelated package defect or an invocation error instead of the dependency diagnostic.
Omitting the affected dependency identity or conflating it with another record.
Invoking a dependency, installing a tool, or fetching remote authority data.
Echoing credentials, absolute host paths or arbitrary inspected text.
oracle.observable: During execution of each explicitly identified test_a09 parameter, inspect the real validate_package result and dependency-execution observers; compare the diagnostic classification and affected record against independent test expectations.

acceptance.then: Missing records, unresolved references and incompatible versions each produce their attributable typed blocking package diagnostic without executing the dependency.
acceptance.when: The authored test_a09 parameters directly invoke scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package with the disposable inspection root, contained package and copied actual policy/schema inputs.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_examples.py::test_a09 with explicit parameter IDs for missing required record, unresolved authority and incompatible version, binding only this obligation's applicable assertion IDs per parameter. Directly call scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package. Expect AssertionError when a defective variant lacks its independently expected typed blocking diagnostic or invokes a dependency. Run the targeted argv command with a caller-enforced 300-second timeout; an unconditional-pass validator must fail these assertions.

For the same test_a09 invocation and integration lane, reject missing tests, missing production import, invalid fixtures, environment errors, missing parameter execution, absent real-entry binding or timeout as harness failures. Freeze tests/helpers before formal RED and never relabel these failures as observable product AssertionError. If the absent foundation entry cannot be established under the existing protocol, block before TDD rather than seed production.
